_note: GIBS entries were read from the WMTS GetCapabilities for EPSG:3857 'best' on 2026-11-14 (identifier, TileMatrixSet, format, default time). The browser fetches tiles straight from GIBS.

layers.title: Satellite photo
layers.description: A clear NASA photo of the land from 29 April 2026, sharp enough to see single fields. Field shapes change little from year to year.
layers.attribution: NASA EOSDIS GIBS, HLS (Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2)

layers.title: Crop greenness
layers.description: How green the plants are, from satellite (NDVI). Dark green is dense, healthy growth.

layers.title: Soil wetness
layers.description: How wet the soil is around the roots, from the SMAP satellite. Each square is about 9 km.

layers.title: Crop stress risk
layers.description: How often crops here do worse than normal in the chosen month. Built from 20+ years of NASA data. Ireland only.
